description: This file defines interfaces and classes for chat event handling in an Orleans-based application, including creation, posting, deletion, and editing of chat messages, with serialization attributes and methods to update XML documents.

classes.name: IChatEvent
classes.description: Interface for chat events that defines a method to update an XML document.

classes.name: CreatedEvent
classes.description: Represents a chat creation event, updating the XML document with creation details.

classes.name: PostedEvent
classes.description: Represents a chat message post event, adding a new post to the XML document.

classes.name: DeletedEvent
classes.description: Represents a chat message deletion event, removing a post from the XML document.

classes.name: EditedEvent
classes.description: Represents a chat message edit event, updating the text of an existing post.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Method implemented by each event class to modify the XML document accordingly.
